notes: New look. Cleaner colours, a menu with icons, and a proper dark mode. Order Sheet: a one-line Priced by choice, shorter rows that fit the screen, supplier names that stay at the top as you scroll, and a Ticked only switch. Ordering: the order you are building is listed with its total, past orders fold up, a Recent orders page with a way back to it, and a red dot on suppliers with an order waiting. Recipes: Priced by as a drop-down, totals beside the ingredients on a wide screen, and a Method box that grows. Less-used buttons are under More. Costing opens on a period that has orders. Press / to search. Fixed: a failed sign-in to the online copy now shows the reason. Nothing you have saved changes.
